properties.note: Lowest verified minimum of the H2C=O...H2NCH3 reactant complex: the amine-lone-pair-toward-carbonyl-carbon (n->C) contact conformer, C1=O2 1.21 A, C1...N3 2.60 A, O...N 3.08 A, no N-H...O contact; combined opt+freq, 0 imaginary frequencies, reproduced by two independent optimisations (this file and the ts_0001 workflow's own product-side endpoint job). Conformers: the N-H...O hydrogen-bonded complex rc1/c001/rc1_c001.log at -210.217581302 Ha is 0.30 kcal/mol HIGHER; against it the e1 barrier would be 27.8 kcal/mol. rc1/c002 and rc1/pull275 are the same H-bonded minimum; rc1/c000 rejected (1 imaginary frequency).

concerted 4-membered addition saddle: C1...N3 1.59 A, C1-O2 1.32 A, transferring H 1.19 A from N3 / 1.42 A from O2; proton-dominated imaginary mode (heavy-atom weight ~1%). Barrier 28.1 kcal/mol = E(TS1) - E(RC1 lowest minimum -210.218065844); 27.8 kcal/mol against the 0.30 kcal/mol higher N-H...O conformer.

Lowest verified carbinolamine minimum CH3-NH-CH2-OH and the barrier reference for e2. Bound to the combined opt+freq log of the minimum reached by the e1 IRC (bare annotation 'smiles: CNCO'), which reproduces the separately optimised int1/A structure to 1.4e-8 Ha; int1/A/int1_A.log, int1/C (+3.92) and int1/D (+3.69 kcal/mol) are the other conformers examined.

neutral 4-membered dehydration saddle, C1-O2 about 2.0 A, late proton-transferred; proton-dominated imaginary mode (H 0.97, N3-H5 0.81, O2-H5 0.96, C1-O2 0.07). Barrier 57.9 kcal/mol = E(TS2) - E(INT1 lowest).
N-methylmethanimine hydrogen-bonded to water (H...N 1.83 A). p1/B2 is a first-order saddle (1 imaginary, -45.5 cm-1), not a conformer. E(P1)-E(INT1) = +9.3 kcal/mol: gas-phase dehydration is uphill.

channel-specific pre-reaction complex of the water-relay route (no incoming graph edge: a barrierless association has no saddle for via), so e3 is comparable to e2 only as an electronic difference. Lowest verified minimum; conformers b3_D -286.623396692, b3_E -286.616853902, b3_C -286.612158484. This lowest pose is NOT the cyclic bridging pose: the water sits on the amine N (Ow-H...N3 1.93 A; water O 4.21 A from the hydroxyl O), so the 36.4 kcal/mol barrier includes the conformational pre-organisation into the bridging pose. IRC-reached complex = -286.617502946 Ha, 3.9 kcal/mol above this minimum (that reference gives 32.5 kcal/mol).
water-relay dehydration saddle (6-membered ring): C...O 2.0 A, C-N 1.35 A; imaginary mode is the N-H / water O-H / O2-H relay (heavy-atom weight ~1%).

imine + 2 H2O as a water chain to the imine N. Alternative arrangement pw/pw_alt6b -286.606972411 is 0.9 kcal/mol higher. E(Pw)-E(INTw lowest) = +9.4 kcal/mol. Bound to the combined opt+freq log of the same minimum whose input carries the bare annotation line 'smiles: C=NC.O.O' (identical energy); the ts_prepare endpoint log it was previously bound to carried no smiles token.

edges.channel: neutral concerted addition (C-N attack with N-H -> carbonyl O relay); barrier = E(TS1) - E(lowest reactant-complex minimum, the n->C contact conformer -210.218065844) = 28.1 kcal/mol; 27.8 kcal/mol against the 0.30 kcal/mol higher N-H...O hydrogen-bonded conformer

neutral concerted dehydration (4-membered ring); barrier = E(TS2) - E(INT1 lowest) = 57.9 kcal/mol; rate-determining step of the neutral path (proton transferred in this step is the remaining N-H, atom H6, because e1 already moved H5 onto O2)

explicit-water relay dehydration (general-acid mimic; relay water = O7/H8/H9); barrier = E(TS2w) - E(INTw lowest b3_B2) = 36.4 kcal/mol (32.5 kcal/mol from the IRC-reached INTw pose). This is the cheaper of the two dehydration channels, i.e. the arm consistent with the pH 4-6 optimum. (relay transfers the remaining N-H, atom H6; H5 already sits on O2 after e1)
